1936, February
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 89 Feb. 4 L. Bierchke - 41 - Escaped serious operation - diagnosed by four competent Drs. as cancer - went to hospital just dread of losing her breast, was here last - a week Monday 27 Jan. - and enrolled in S. Mass as promising an offering + is (1.00) every month for year if things went favorably. Next day doctor told - could find nothing - Patient wept. April 4 " ... 100 % OK ...
4 Mrs. Jules Goslin - Gagetown, Mich. - 50 - gave birth to baby 7 months ago after an accident. Last Wednesday rushed to hospital and operated on - very little hope To-day.
Margaret Colombo - 71 in June - Pneumonia.
5 Mrs. Susan Mergaest - 39 - fears cancer operation. .wants to have prayers of thanksgiving for favors received.
Mrs. Ely Fenwick - 65 - broke ankle and foot last Monday. Folks fear serious trouble.
Eleanor Taylor - 31 - T.B. feared - has husband & twin daughters 4 yrs. old.
Page 90 Blank Page
Page 91
Feb. 5 Catherine Van Poucker - 65 - fell Nov. 23 is still in cast with leg broken & in pain.
6 Alex Wheelihan - 57 - of Battle Creek, Mich. - cancer of liver - Gall bladder - very threatening - His sister enrolles him To-day 5 - % (Br. Fr.)
Mrs. Mary Weins - 64 - cancer of lung and liver
Mrs. Helen M. Swain - 42 - inward cancer - has husband and four smal children - Operated on 12 months ago. Now appearing again.
Mrs. Juels Goslin - 47 - has 4 small children & husband - Enrolled last Tuesday - perp'ly - baby (8mo.) taken out of side - now threat- ened with blood infection.
Thomas Hall - 6 - had tooth draun ... bleeding since 2 a.m. Now at 10 P.M. (20 hours) still bleeding. Mother calls up Enroll him ....
Mrs. Eleanore Faber - 34 - successful operation on goitre - Deo Gr .! and at same time ask prayers of thanksgiving praying 12 yrs. for family without appearand results - now O.K ....
